title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 19, 2026, relative to donations valued at $12,000.00 for
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 19, 2026, relative to donations valued at $12,000.00 for
  a Quarter Horse Gelding, “Caliber” to join Metropolitan Division’s Mounted Platoon, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-343]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: A donation valued at $12,000.00 of a quarter horse gelding named Caliber to join the Metropolitan Division's Mounted Platoon. The Police Commission is asked to approve the report.
